operations.name: AtomicBulkEdits.edit_transactions
operations.summary: Atomically edit mixed transaction annotations with one guarded native commit and durable save.

input.description: Operation parameters.

workspace.description: Host-scoped isolated workspace.

edits.description: 1–100 explicit, distinct targets; at least one supported change per item. Never split.

transactionId.description: Stable active transaction ID; never a merchant/name.

categoryId.description: Existing child ID; null clears. Omit to preserve.

categoryAgent.description: Self-declared categorizer label (1–80 printable characters); null clears; requires categoryId.

reviewed.description: Explicit review status; omit to preserve.

note.description: Replace exactly; empty string clears; omit to preserve. Cannot accompany appendNote.

appendNote.description: Append verbatim with one newline after a nonempty existing note. Final note max 1000. Cannot accompany note.

output.description: Exact native validated records, returned only after one successful commit/checkpoint, or read-only preview. count includes no-op targets; changed counts differing public records.

changes.description: Every target in input order with complete public before/after records. Permanent history separately retains exact internal financial rows.

operations.side_effects: One atomic native transaction, coherent reversible audit entry, durable receipt, revision advancement and synchronous durable checkpoint. Every item validates before any record is changed. No bank sync. Omitted fields preserved.
operations.permissions: Host-scoped optional SDK callback; never arbitrary native storage access through HTTP.
operations.scope: Exactly one addressed budget/environment/workspace. IDs do not select another budget.
errors: 1–100 distinct targets; invalid/missing/deleted/foreign/duplicate/disallowed items reject the whole batch. No splitting or partial success.
Core category currency, account type/subtype/scope and annotation bounds apply. Unsupported backends fail before mutation.
Stale revisions and conflicting request reuse fail. Uncertain responses may have committed; inspect history and preserve the original intent.
operations.retry: Exact original operation/workspace/resolved edits/revision/request ID/history returns its original durable receipt without changes/history/save, including after restart. Never retry an uncertain mutation with fresh intent. Bounded receipt expiry rejects stale requests. Preview is read-only and does not reserve its revision.
operations.availability: WHAB 2.72+, optional AtomicBulkEdits; SQLite 1.23+ and JSON 1.15+; remote authority must support it.
